title: Best Team With No Conflicts
statement:
Each player has an age and score. A conflict occurs when a younger player has a strictly higher score than an older player. Choose any team with no conflicts and return the largest total score. Players of the same age may have different scores.

## Examples

```text
Input: scores = [1, 3, 5, 10, 15], ages = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Output: 34
```

```text
Input: scores = [4, 5, 6, 5], ages = [2, 1, 2, 1]
Output: 16
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= scores.length == ages.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= scores[i] <= 10^6`
- `1 <= ages[i] <= 1000`
